overview: The Medford City Council reviewed Community Preservation Act funding for Thomas Brooks Park, received a progress update on the Lawrence Memorial Hospital development, and approved resolutions on traffic safety, fire station repairs, and a school fundraiser.

items.title: Thomas Brooks Park Master Implementation Plan Phase One
items.summary: The council recommended approval of Community Preservation Act funding for Phase One improvements at Thomas Brooks Park, including wall restorations and an archaeological dig, with amendments governing artifact placement and park commission jurisdiction.

items.title: Lawrence Memorial Hospital Campus Update
items.summary: Hospital representatives presented an update on the newly completed ambulatory surgery center, ongoing COVID-19 response efforts, exterior lighting modifications, and campus traffic management. The council requested a traffic review of a Governor's Avenue speed hump and scheduled another update in 60 days.

items.title: Resolutions on Behavioral Health Commission and Financial Recap
items.summary: Resolutions requesting updates on the Behavioral Health Commission and a municipal financial recap were withdrawn because both topics will be addressed in upcoming Committee of the Whole meetings.

items.title: Gender Equity Commission Ordinance
items.summary: The council voted to advance the proposed Gender Equity Commission Ordinance and requested an updated draft from the city solicitor.

items.title: Pedestrian Crosswalk on Fells Avenue
items.summary: The council approved a resolution requesting a crosswalk installation at Fells Avenue and Hickory Avenue and scheduled a follow-up Committee of the Whole meeting on neighborhood traffic safety.

items.title: Fire Station Facilities Update
items.summary: The council approved a resolution requesting an update from the administration regarding roof leaks at Engine 4 and Engine 6 and the timeline for hiring a project manager for fire facilities.

items.title: Food Truck Fundraiser at Andrews Middle School
items.summary: The council granted conditional approval for two food trucks to operate a parent-teacher organization fundraiser at the Andrews Middle School on February 10, 2021, contingent on School Committee authorization.

items.title: Committee of the Whole Report on Personnel Positions
items.summary: The council accepted a report from the January 19, 2021 Committee of the Whole meeting regarding municipal personnel positions, at which no formal action was taken.
